capabilities.boundary: Wave 3 is deterministic, offline reasoning over caller-supplied JSON: it checks structure, policy arithmetic and byte-level provenance, never truth, safety, identity or settlement. A finding is evidence for a human decision, not a verdict on a third party. VERIFIED ≠ SAFE; no network calls, no keys, no wall clock in any commitment.
